name: get_product_details

productRef.description: Opaque productRef from search_products. It identifies the item. The marketplace comes from country.

country.description: Marketplace: DE (Germany), AT (Austria), GB or UK (United Kingdom), FR (France), IT (Italy), ES (Spain). An omitted or unknown code uses Germany.

type.description: Catalog item shape from search result `itemType`. Omit unless you need CLUSTER or SINGLE_OFFER.
